svg.text: What is confirmed vs claimed, Irkutsk death
Confirmed in wires: a 28-year-old institute employee died; Russia cites pneumonia of unknown origin.
Trump: a call with Putin is scheduled. Peskov (BBC): no call was scheduled.
CBS: Moscow open to a prompt call; nothing on the calendar.
WHO via CBC: risk outside Russia “very low”; more lab detail requested.
Broken-tube plague account: Russian media, not a published lab finding.
Schematic of claims. Not a case count.
